candidate_workaround: Pipe the complete PowerShell here-string explicitly to Python, keep the recovery probe minimal, and require a structured success value before granting review credit.
failure_signature: An intended staged AST audit omitted the here-string pipeline, so PowerShell printed the Python source instead of executing it; the printed source also contained an unparsed bracket error.
recurrence_guard: Require an explicit pipeline or script invocation for every inline-language probe and accept only a structured result emitted by the invoked interpreter.
rollback: Retain the printed-but-unexecuted probe with zero review credit and change no evidence claim until a minimal explicit invocation passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner command-wrapper recovery only; no scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, production, security, accessibility, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Require explicit execution for inline audit probes
trigger_preconditions: A PowerShell here-string contains inline code intended for another interpreter.
